'''2011 Minnesota State Championship Michael Pistone DS A Stunning Move''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Michael Pistone]] at [[2011 Minnesota State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|A Stunning Move / A Valuable Hostage|V11-D-astunningmove.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' I Can't Believe It's Not Light Side!
* '''Username:''' Pistone84
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.3]]
